name: Storage
description: A Durable Object with a small typed store of records, in named collections.
fits: Add it when an app started from the Worker Template has to remember things, such as the messages a webhook receives.
edits: Export the class from the Worker's main module (main in wrangler.jsonc), such as `export { Store } from "./server/store";` in src/index.ts.
In worker-configuration.d.ts, add `STORE: DurableObjectNamespace<import("./src/server/store").Store>;` to the __BaseEnv_Env interface.
